question: What solvent mixture, at what volume ratio, was used to extract the cubic samples, and at what temperature and for how long?
expect: dichloromethane/methanol 93:7 (v/v), water bath at 40 °C for 14 days (fluid changed every 2-3 days) (sec. 2.2)
rendered: The solvent mixture used to extract the cubic samples was dichloromethane and methanol, at a volume ratio of 93:7. The samples were placed in a water bath at 40 °C for 14 days to remove the oil in the samples as a batch. The mixed fluids were changed every 2−3 days to ensure a high solvent extraction efficiency.
